english: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
text: a wonderful place for a picnic 不是只夸地点漂亮，而是评价它适合野餐。说某处适合某种活动，可用 a good place for a walk 或 a good place to study，让评价落到具体用途上。
